scene_report.narration_text: Bhasmasura was a powerful demon who sought a dangerous gift from the god Lord Shiva.
According to the supplied account, he performed intense prayers to earn a boon from the deity.
scene_report.main_action: Emitting a thin trail of smoke

scene_report.narration_text: Shiva granted him the terrifying power to turn anyone into ashes by touching their head.
scene_report.main_action: Displaying a symbolic seal of power

scene_report.narration_text: The demon immediately turned his sights on his benefactor, forcing Shiva to flee for his life.
scene_report.main_action: Leaning against a rocky cliff edge

scene_report.narration_text: Lord Vishnu intervened with a plan, transforming into the beautiful enchantress Mohini to confront the threat.
scene_report.main_action: Lying on a polished marble floor

scene_report.narration_text: Captivated by her, Bhasmasura agreed to her condition that he must perfectly mimic her dance.
As they danced, Mohini raised her hand and placed it upon her own head.
Without thinking, the demon followed her lead and touched his own head.
In a single second, Bhasmasura turned himself into ashes.
This mythological tale highlights how the demon's own lethal power became his undoing.
Ultimately, the only person Bhasmasura managed to destroy was himself.
